# dagsterplus_agent_token (Resource)

Manages a Dagster+ agent token. The token value is only available at creation time; it cannot be recovered after import. Changing the name forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_agent_token" "hybrid_agent" {
  name = "hybrid-agent-token"
}

output "agent_token_value" {
  value     = dagsterplus_agent_token.hybrid_agent.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The label for the agent token. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The token ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The agent token value. Only populated on creation; not recoverable after import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agent tokens are imported using the token ID assigned by Dagster+.
# The token ID can be found via the Dagster+ API (ListAgentTokens query).
# IMPORTANT: The token value (secret) is only available at creation time and
# cannot be recovered after import. The `token` attribute will be empty after
# import — plan accordingly (e.g. use ignore_changes or recreate the token).
terraform import dagsterplus_agent_token.example <token_id>
```
